# Dr. Vikram Barua Kaushik | Urologist & Robotic Surgeon

> Dr. Vikram Barua Kaushik provides specialist urology care with clear diagnosis, personalised treatment planning, minimally invasive procedures and robotic surgery.

This website provides patient-friendly information about urology consultation, kidney stones, prostate problems, urinary symptoms, bladder concerns, male infertility, erectile dysfunction, urethral stricture, urinary tract infection, urological cancer evaluation, robotic urology, treatment planning, appointment booking, and international patient support.

## Primary Website

- [Home](https://drvikrambaruakaushik.com): Overview of Dr. Vikram's urology and robotic surgery care.
- [Contact](https://drvikrambaruakaushik.com/contact-us): Appointment form, phone, email, timings, and clinic locations.
- [Treatment Journey](https://drvikrambaruakaushik.com/treatment-journey): How consultation, report review, treatment planning, and follow-up work.
- [International Patient Support](https://drvikrambaruakaushik.com/international-patient-support): Support for patients travelling for consultation or surgery.
- [Testimonials](https://drvikrambaruakaushik.com/testimonials): Patient experiences and recovery stories.
- [Video Gallery](https://drvikrambaruakaushik.com/video-gallery): Educational urology videos and explainers.
